import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

# ---------- RefSeq check ----------
try:
    e=requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi",
        params={"db":"nuccore","term":"GLO1[gene] AND Homo sapiens[orgn] AND srcdb_refseq[prop] AND biomol_mrna[prop]","retmode":"json","retmax":20},timeout=60).json()
    ids=e['esearchresult']['idlist']
    s=requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi",
        params={"db":"nuccore","id":",".join(ids),"retmode":"json"},timeout=60).json()
    print("RefSeq mRNAs for human GLO1:")
    for i in ids:
        r=s['result'][i]; print("  ",r['caption'],r['title'][:95],"len",r['slen'])
except Exception as ex:
    print("RefSeq query failed:",ex)

# ---------- rebuild structural numbers ----------
three2one={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'ZN':1.39,'I':1.98}
def parse(txt):
    o=[]
    for L in txt.splitlines():
        if L.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")) and L[16] in (' ','A'):
            o.append(dict(rec=L[:6].strip(),name=L[12:16].strip(),resn=L[17:20].strip(),ch=L[21],ri=int(L[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])]),
                elem=(L[76:78].strip() or L[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()))
    return o
def sasa(ats,probe=1.4,n=192):
    ga=np.pi*(3-np.sqrt(5)); i=np.arange(n); y=1-2*i/(n-1); r=np.sqrt(np.clip(1-y*y,0,None)); th=ga*i
    pts=np.stack([np.cos(th)*r,y,np.sin(th)*r],1)
    X=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in ats]); R=np.array([VDW.get(a['elem'],1.7)+probe for a in ats])
    tree=cKDTree(X); Rm=R.max(); out=np.zeros(len(ats))
    for k in range(len(ats)):
        nb=[j for j in tree.query_ball_point(X[k],R[k]+Rm) if j!=k]
        sp=X[k]+R[k]*pts
        acc=np.ones(n,bool) if not nb else (np.linalg.norm(sp[:,None,:]-X[nb][None,:,:],axis=2)>=R[nb][None,:]).all(1)
        out[k]=4*np.pi*R[k]**2*acc.mean()
    return out
at=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1QIN.pdb",timeout=120).text)
prot=[a for a in at if a['rec']=='ATOM' and a['resn'] in three2one and a['ch'] in ('A','B')]
A=[a for a in prot if a['ch']=='A']; B=[a for a in prot if a['ch']=='B']
zn=[a for a in at if a['resn']=='ZN']; gip=[a for a in at if a['resn']=='GIP']
sm=sasa(A); sd=sasa(A+B)[:len(A)]
rm=defaultdict(float); rd=defaultdict(float)
for a,x,y in zip(A,sm,sd): rm[a['ri']]+=x; rd[a['ri']]+=y
byres=defaultdict(list)
for a in prot: byres[(a['ch'],a['ri'])].append(a)
DEL=list(range(104,119))
rows=[dict(UniProt=p+1,aa=three2one[byres[('A',p)][0]['resn']],
     d_Zn=min(np.linalg.norm(a['xyz']-z['xyz']) for a in byres[('A',p)] for z in zn),
     d_inh=min(np.linalg.norm(a['xyz']-g['xyz']) for a in byres[('A',p)] for g in gip),
     BSA=rm[p]-rd[p]) for p in DEL]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
ca={(a['ch'],a['ri']):a['xyz'] for a in prot if a['name']=='CA'}
gap=np.linalg.norm(ca[('A',103)]-ca[('A',119)])
bsa_all=sum(rm[p]-rd[p] for p in rm)
print("\n=== PROVENANCE TABLE (1QIN, UniProt numbering = PDB + 1) ===")
print(df.to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.2f}"))
print(f"\nZn ligands: Q34, E100 (same chain) + H127, E173 (partner chain)  -> none inside 105-119")
print(f"Annotated substrate-binding residues: 34,38,104,123,127,157,158,173 -> none inside 105-119")
print(f"Interface burial by 105-119: {df.BSA.sum():.0f} A^2 of {bsa_all:.0f} A^2 total ({100*df.BSA.sum()/bsa_all:.1f}%)")
print(f"Splice-junction gap Ca(104)-Ca(120) = {gap:.2f} A (peptide bond needs ~3.8 A)")

# ---------- figure ----------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,8))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,hspace=0.45,wspace=0.3)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
ax.bar(df.UniProt,df.d_Zn,color='#4C78A8'); ax.axhline(5,color='#E45756',ls='--',lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel('UniProt residue'); ax.set_ylabel('min distance to Zn (A)')
ax.set_title('a. Deleted segment vs catalytic zinc\nclosest atom 9.5 A; no Zn ligand inside',fontsize=10)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
ax.bar(df.UniProt,df.d_inh,color='#F58518'); ax.axhline(4,color='#E45756',ls='--',lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel('UniProt residue'); ax.set_ylabel('min distance to GIP inhibitor (A)')
ax.set_title('b. Distance to transition-state analogue\nY115 and N119 are second shell',fontsize=10)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
ax.bar(df.UniProt,df.BSA,color='#72B7B2')
ax.set_xlabel('UniProt residue'); ax.set_ylabel('buried on dimerisation (A$^2$)')
ax.set_title(f'c. Dimer-interface contribution\n{df.BSA.sum():.0f} of {bsa_all:.0f} A$^2$ = {100*df.BSA.sum()/bsa_all:.0f}%',fontsize=10)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ax.bar(['Ca104 to Ca120\nin 1QIN','peptide bond\nrequirement'],[gap,3.8],color=['#54A24B','#E45756'])
for i,v in enumerate([gap,3.8]): ax.text(i,v+0.5,f'{v:.1f} A',ha='center')
ax.set_ylabel('distance (A)'); ax.set_title('d. Isoform 2 splice junction is\ngeometrically impossible in the native fold',fontsize=10)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1:])
ax.axis('off')
topo=[("beta 34-38 (Q34 Zn ligand, R38 GSH)",34,38,'#4C78A8'),("alpha 42-51",42,51,'#BAB0AC'),
      ("beta 56-63",56,63,'#4C78A8'),("beta 68-74",68,74,'#4C78A8'),("alpha 85-94",85,94,'#BAB0AC'),
      ("beta 98-104 (E100 Zn ligand, N104 GSH)",98,104,'#4C78A8'),("DELETED 105-119",105,119,'#E45756'),
      ("beta 128-131 (after H127 Zn ligand)",128,131,'#4C78A8'),("alpha 135-144",135,144,'#BAB0AC'),
      ("beta 161-165",161,165,'#4C78A8'),("beta 171-175 (E173 Zn ligand / base)",171,175,'#4C78A8')]
for nm,s,e,c in topo:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,0.4),e-s+1,0.25,color=c))
    ax.text((s+e)/2,0.70 if s not in (105,98) else 0.26,nm,rotation=35 if s!=105 else 0,fontsize=7.5,
            ha='center',va='bottom' if s not in (105,98) else 'top',color='k')
ax.plot([2,184],[0.525,0.525],color='k',lw=0.8,zorder=0)
ax.set_xlim(0,190); ax.set_ylim(0,1.1)
ax.set_title('e. GLO1 topology: 105-119 is the crossover connector between the two VOC modules\n'
             '(strand 98-104 carrying Zn ligand E100  ->  strand 128-131 following Zn ligand H127)',fontsize=10)
plt.show()
